cases.name: text mode still prints the next batch
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py $d/todo/x/X-PLAN.md | cut -d' ' -f1

cases.name: --next returns the batch of the current repo as JSON and journals its launch
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/X-PLAN.md --next $d/j.md | grep -o '"outsideBatch": "F2", "outsidePaths": \[\]' | tr '\n' ';'; cut -d' ' -f1-2 $d/j.md

cases.name: --next lists the out-of-batch paths and journals nothing
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; mkdir -p $d/docs; echo y > $d/docs/y.md; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/X-PLAN.md --next $d/j.md | grep -o '"outsidePaths": \["docs/y.md"\]' | tr '\n' ';'; test -e $d/j.md && echo journal || echo no-journal

cases.name: --context gathers earlier audit gaps, user decisions and absent cited paths
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; mkdir -p $d/todo/x/run/F1 $d/src/A; printf '## STATUS — DONE

## Audit gaps

- Major — rejected choice X

## End
' > $d/todo/x/run/F1/F1-report.md; printf '
| H1 | user decision: Y |
`src/A/B.cs` `src/A/C.cs` `src/**/*.cs`
' >> $d/todo/x/X-PLAN-F2.md; touch $d/src/A/C.cs; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/X-PLAN.md --context F2 | grep -E '^- Major|user decision|^src/|^cycles' | tr '
' ';'

expect.stdout: - Major — rejected choice X;X-PLAN-F2.md:2: | H1 | user decision: Y |;cycles: none;src/A/B.cs;

cases.name: a French plan (Execution des lots, Lot / Depend de / Dépôt, ✅ DONE) prints the next batch
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/Y-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/Y-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py $d/todo/x/Y-PLAN.md | cut -d' ' -f1

cases.name: --next reads a French plan and journals the launch in English
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/Y-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/Y-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/Y-PLAN.md --next $d/j.md | grep -o '"kind": "BATCHES"' | tr '\n' ';'; cut -d' ' -f1-2 $d/j.md

cases.name: --check reads a French plan
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/Y-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/Y-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py $d/todo/x/Y-PLAN.md --check

cases.name: --check reads an English plan
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py $d/todo/x/X-PLAN.md --check

cases.name: --context reads the French run layout: run/lots/FY.md with « Écarts d'audit », « décision utilisateur », run/.travail cycles
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/Y-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/Y-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; mkdir -p $d/todo/x/run/lots $d/todo/x/run/.travail/F2/cycles; printf '## STATUT — TERMINÉ

## Écarts d'"'"'audit

- Majeur — choix X rejeté

## Fin
' > $d/todo/x/run/lots/F1.md; printf '{"behaviour": "One", "green": true}' > $d/todo/x/run/.travail/F2/cycles/a.json; printf '
| H1 | décision utilisateur : Y |
| H2 | décision user à valider : Z |
' >> $d/todo/x/Y-PLAN-F2.md; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/Y-PLAN.md --context F2 | grep -E '^- Majeur|décision|^cycle' | tr '
' ';'

expect.stdout: - Majeur — choix X rejeté;Y-PLAN-F2.md:2: | H1 | décision utilisateur : Y |;Y-PLAN-F2.md:3: | H2 | décision user à valider : Z |;cycle a.json: One — green;

cases.name: --context reads the English run layout: run/batches/FY.md with « Audit gaps », « user decision », run/.work cycles
cases.cmd:
d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/X-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/X-PLAN-F2.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; mkdir -p $d/todo/x/run/batches $d/todo/x/run/.work/F2/cycles; printf '## STATUS — DONE

## Audit gaps

- Major — rejected choice X

## End
' > $d/todo/x/run/batches/F1.md; printf '{"behaviour": "One", "green": true}' > $d/todo/x/run/.work/F2/cycles/a.json; printf '
| H1 | user decision: Y |
| H2 | user decision to validate: Z |
' >> $d/todo/x/X-PLAN-F2.md; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/X-PLAN.md --context F2 | grep -E '^- Major|user decision|^cycle' | tr '
' ';'

expect.stdout: - Major — rejected choice X;X-PLAN-F2.md:2: | H1 | user decision: Y |;X-PLAN-F2.md:3: | H2 | user decision to validate: Z |;cycle a.json: One — green;

cases.name: without --skip the dependant of a ✅ DONE batch launches
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/Z-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/Z-PLAN-F3.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py $d/todo/x/Z-PLAN.md | cut -d' ' -f1

cases.name: --skip reads a ✅ DONE batch as not done, holds its dependants back and ends the plan
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/Z-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/Z-PLAN-F3.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py $d/todo/x/Z-PLAN.md --skip F2

cases.name: --next with --skip names the held batches and what holds them
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/Z-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/Z-PLAN-F3.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/Z-PLAN.md --skip F2 --next $d/j.md | grep -o '"kind": "END"\|"held": \[{"batch": "F3", "by": \["F2"\]}\]' | tr '\n' ';'

cases.name: --skip on a French plan: same reading, same English output
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/W-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/W-PLAN-F3.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py $d/todo/x/W-PLAN.md --skip F2

cases.name: --next with --skip on a French plan names the held batches
cases.cmd: d=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p $d/todo/x; cp {{FIX}}/W-PLAN.md {{FIX}}/W-PLAN-F3.md $d/todo/x/; git -C $d init -q; cd $d && python3 {{KIT}}/scripts/plan-next-batch.py todo/x/W-PLAN.md --skip F2 --next $d/j.md | grep -o '"held": \[{"batch": "F3", "by": \["F2"\]}\]' | tr '\n' ';'
